audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill x5, Locke at first item, Skill at 2+ items, and both full phases[].side and content win[] match it exactly. 49.93% over 745 games supports an even lane with a Locke item window. No flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike is correctly identified but has no number behind it. Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100s — the longest ultimate cooldown in the matchup — and Mourning Mist is 12/11/10/9/8s. Neither appears anywhere on the page.
audit.why: 'Kill him at 6 before the Maiden saves him' becomes a plan once the player knows the Maiden is a 160-second resource at rank 1 and that his poke is on 12s.
audit.corrected: 160s added to mid; 12s added to spikes[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects is right: the content layer never names a single Yorick ability, calling them 'the cage', 'ghouls', 'his E slow' and 'the Maiden'. Also, Dark Procession is destructible terrain, not a pure trap — it can be broken, which changes what a caged Locke should do.
audit.why: Real names are the approved bar. Naming Dark Procession (W), Mourning Mist (E), Last Rites (Q) and Eulogy of the Isles (R) also lets the player track the right cooldowns instead of guessing which button did what.
audit.corrected: Ability names inserted across whys[2], spikes[0], spikes[2], early and wants.foe[0], with Dark Procession described as destructible terrain and Last Rites noted as a heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Yorick's E carries a dash flag in the derived data, but Riot's description of Mourning Mist is a thrown globule that damages, slows and marks — no dash for Yorick himself.
audit.why: Per the rule, when a derived flag contradicts Riot's own text the text wins. I did not write anything that depends on Yorick having a dash, and I did not claim Purgatory's grounding matters here — Yorick is immobile, which is exactly why the level 6 window works.
audit.corrected: No claim made either way; flagged in notes.

edits.before: Level 3 is even as his cage and ghouls meet your Q poke and burst.
edits.after: Level 3 is even: Dark Procession (W) meets your Q poke and burst.

edits.before: Yorick's ghouls (W cage plus E-marked ghoul swarm) zone you off the wave; your P Silver Stake on-hit and Q Ritual Nails let you burst him if you can dodge the E slow, but respect the Maiden by mid-levels.
edits.after: Dark Procession (W) and a Mourning Mist-marked ghoul swarm zone you off the wave; your P on-hit and Q nails burst him if you dodge the E — it is 12s at rank 1 — but respect the Maiden by mid-levels.

edits.before: Yorick's Maiden and ghoul wall carry his damage and split pressure; his W cage traps your E dash-through and the ghoul swarm out-sustains your grey-health poke if you fight into them.
edits.after: The Maiden of the Mist and his ghouls carry his damage and split pressure; Dark Procession (W) is destructible terrain that traps your E dash, and the swarm out-sustains your grey-health poke.

edits.before: Skill matchup early: Yorick's ghouls and E slow zone you, but your P Silver Stake on-hit and Q poke punish him if you avoid the cage and don't feed ghoul stacks. Trade in short windows and back off the Maiden.
edits.after: Skill matchup early: his ghouls and Mourning Mist (E) slow zone you, but your P on-hit and Q poke punish him — Last Rites (Q) heals him, so trade in short windows, avoid Dark Procession, and back off the Maiden.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 stay even on skill, then level 6 flips to you: your R Purgatory totem executes an immobile Yorick under its threshold before his Maiden can save him, so E in with W active and finish inside the zone. That ult window is your best kill setup.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 stay even on skill, then level 6 flips to you: Purgatory executes an immobile Yorick before the Maiden can save him, and Eulogy of the Isles is 160 seconds at rank 1 — kill him in that gap. E in with W active and finish inside the zone.

edits.before: Wall you in with W cage to trap your E dash
edits.after: Trap your E dash with Dark Procession (W)

notes: The packet defect was accurate — the content layer named none of Yorick's abilities; all five are now referenced by their real names. Yorick's E carries a dash flag in the derived data that Riot's own text does not support (it is a thrown globule), so I made no claim about grounding here. 'Ritual Nails' removed from spikes[0] in favour of neutral wording rather than renaming, since the mirror left the display name unverified.
